div.head: Grið 29
div.ab: ⁊ eac is mycel nydþearf manna gehwylcum, þæt he oðrum beode þæt riht, þæt he wille þæt man him beode, be þam þe his mæð sy.
And eac is mycel nydþearf manna gehwylcum, þæt he oðrum beode þæt riht, þæt he wille þæt man him beode, be þam þe his mæð sy.
Und ferner liegt jedem der Menschen starke Pflichtschuld ob, dass er dem anderen das Recht gewähre, welches er wünscht, dass ihm gewährt werde, je nachdem sein Verhältniss ist.
And further, a great duty lies on every person to grant the other the justice that he wishes to be granted to himself, according to his station.
And it is also a great necessity for every person to offer others the justice he wishes to be given to him, just as is his due.
div.note: G reads ‘his’; Liebermann would correct to ‘hit’ (as VI Atr 49).
And it is also a great necessity . . . given to him: A modified version of Matthew 7:12.

note.seg: Ferner stehen I Cn 18 oder Matth. 7, 12 oder letzteren benutzende Hom. n. Wulfstan 29. 38. 67. 73. 112. 144. 179
More remote parallels are I Cn 18 or Matth. 7, 12, or Hom. n. Wulfstan 29. 38. 67. 73. 112. 144. 179, which use the latter
